summary: Iteration 9 (Cloudflare 520 fix on /api/auth/login) fully verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_login_fix.py pass — valid login returns 200 with exact Content-Type 'application/json; charset=utf-8' and body {user, access_token, token_type='bearer'}; wrong password returns 401 with body {'error':'Invalid credentials'} and same Content-Type; unknown email returns identical 401 body (no account enumeration); missing password / empty body / non-JSON body all return 422 (or 400) with well-formed JSON — connection is NOT dropped; no app-level Set-Cookie header on login response (only Cloudflare-injected __cf_bm which is unavoidable at the proxy layer); CORS preflight OPTIONS returns valid headers with no spec-invalid ACAO=* + ACAC=true combo (with CORS_ORIGINS='*' env, allow_credentials is auto-forced to False by server.py:1142); global exception handler (invoked in-process) returns 500 with body {'error':'Internal server error'} and correct Content-Type. Regressions: /api/auth/me works, register duplicate email returns 409. Frontend (Playwright against preview URL): /login with wrong password shows toast text 'INVALID CREDENTIALS' (previously would have said 'Something went wrong'); /login with valid credentials redirects to /dashboard; /register with duplicate email shows toast 'EMAIL ALREADY REGISTERED'. apiErrorMessage() correctly handles both new {error} shape and legacy {detail} shape.

backend.test_login_success_no_set_cookie: PASS (only CF-injected __cf_bm cookie is present, filtered)
backend.test_options_preflight_cors_no_wildcard_: PASS — ACAO=* with ACAC=true combo not present

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1141-1142 CORS conditional is correct: only forces allow_credentials=False when the sole origin is '*'. If CORS_ORIGINS is set to a comma-list of explicit origins in production, credentials will be enabled — good.

server.py:1123 global exception handler is defined AFTER app.include_router(api) and BEFORE CORS middleware add — order is fine because @app.exception_handler is decorator-based (registered on app, not order-dependent). Verified: an unhandled RuntimeError produces JSONResponse(500, {'error':'Internal server error'}) with correct headers.

server.py:414-446 login() has nested try/except with granular error paths (db lookup, token creation, catch-all). Good defensive coding. Minor: the catch-all logs 'unexpected error' but returns 500 — consider distinguishing between validation-shaped errors and true 500s, but not blocking.

server.py:405-411 json_error helper is DRY and enforces Content-Type — good. Consider using it uniformly across other endpoints (currently register/me/etc still use HTTPException with 'detail' shape). Frontend apiErrorMessage() handles both so no user-facing bug, but consistency would be nice.

auth-context.js:34,45 correctly uses apiErrorMessage(e) — legacy formatApiErrorDetail is still exported from api.js but unused in auth flows; keep for other components that may still consume {detail}.
test_credentials: Ephemeral users registered via /api/auth/register each run (test_login_*@pirate.radio / testpass123 and test_fe_*@pirate.radio / testpass123). DJ SPARKZ (markysparks99@gmail.com) NOT touched. testdj@pirate.radio / testpass123 from prior iterations still valid.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 Cloudflare 520 fix fully green.
